title: Grateful Dead Live at Family Dog at the Great Highway on 1970-03-01
venue: Family Dog at the Great Highway

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a stellar show highlighted by a memorable Cryptical reprise and a vivid Uncle John’s Band moment.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the pristine soundboard source, calling it “excellent” and “crisp,” while also praising the performance as a true Dead classic – especially the Cryptical reprise and the banjo‑mandolin texture on Uncle John’s Band. No flaws are noted, making both the music and recording highly enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers gave high marks (5‑4‑5) and consistently praised both the performance and the soundboard quality, indicating an overall excellent show with a top‑notch recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp soundboard; no dropouts or muddiness mentioned. Reviewers describe it as “excellent” and “very good.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers note the show feels like a “real deal,” with memorable moments that flow naturally; no pacing issues reported.
